text:
The median asking rent in Nuremberg stands at 12.89 €/m², up 4.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.3 % over the last five years, placing the city 14th among the 37 most expensive markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 11.13 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 14.92 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 773 € per month.

Market tightness remains pronounced: vacancy is only 1.6 %, days on market average 31, and 18 % of listings are let within a week. The rent‑burden for two residents is 17.1 %, and asking rents sit 57 % above the 2022 existing‑rent benchmark of 8.21 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 13.55 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 13.24 – 13.85 €/m², implying a 5.1 % increase.
